text.arabic_uthmani: فَٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

words.gloss_range: prefixed consequence and sequence particle; locally it launches the imperative as the practical result of the previous disclosure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the imperative launched by the opening consequence particle

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens the ayah as a consequence, not as a loose continuation. It carries the previous signs-and-provision scene into an immediate command, so invocation becomes the required response rather than an optional reflection. The addressees move from recipients of evidence into responsible callers facing anticipated hostility. Because it is fused to {{ar:ٱدْعُوا۟}} ({{tr:udʿū}}), the logical turn and the command arrive as one compressed launch.

topics.headline: consequence becomes command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command follows from the previous disclosure instead of beginning a detached devotional topic.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the opening particle as a prefixed conjunction, and the attachment evidence makes the following imperative the main clause grounded by the prior discourse.

topics.headline: particle fusion compresses the turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the turn from evidence to action as tightly attached to the imperative.
topics.reason: The particle is prefixed to the imperative, and the command force is syntactically forced in the local clause.

topics.headline: evidence scene turns into responsibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the addressees moving from recipients of evidence into responsible callers under coming opposition.
topics.reason: The cross-reference evidence keeps the plural addressees in view after 40:13, while the CRITICAL rows identify the discourse boundary as a move from diagnosis to prescribed action.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperative to call, invoke, summon, or appeal; locally direct command with the divine name as explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: broad calling field also includes claim and other remote branches; the local Form I imperative selects directed invocation and excludes self-claim as the active branch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the explicit divine object of the imperative

words.prose: {{ar:ٱدْعُوا۟}} ({{tr:udʿū}}) is a plural imperative, so the ayah assigns the audience a shared act rather than describing an inner state. Those who received signs and provision now become the commanded callers. Its object is explicit in {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}), making the call directed before sincerity, dīn, or opposition is introduced. The root {{ar:د ع و}} ({{tr:d-ʿ-w}}) keeps summons and supplication together, while local Form I command blocks the claim-branch: the callers appeal to God rather than asserting entitlement for themselves. The same compact discipline returns in the surah's fuller formula (40:65), pulling invocation into allegiance and accountability, and it answers the prohibition on shared invocation (72:18).

topics.headline: plural imperative makes invocation public
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response is assigned to the hearers as a collective speech-act, not left as private assent.
topics.reason: QAC and translation support identify a second-person masculine plural imperative with morphologically present subject agreement.

topics.headline: the call is not open-ended
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that invocation is fixed on the named divine object before any manner phrase appears.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes word 3 the explicit accusative object of the imperative, and the verb frame has an explicit object.

topics.headline: summons and supplication survive, claim does not
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worship being cast as directed appeal toward God while self-asserting claim branches are kept out of the local action.
topics.reason: V4 includes a calling branch and a claim branch for the root, but the local surface is the Form I imperative with an explicit divine object, so the claim branch functions only as contrast.

topics.headline: the command belongs to an exclusive-invocation formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this command is not isolated: it participates in the same-surah pure-dīn formula (40:65) and the wider ban on shared invocation (72:18).
topics.reason: The contextual evidence supports recurrent pairing with the divine name, dīn, and purity language, while the CRITICAL rows supply concrete references at 40:65 and 72:18.

topics.headline: the imperative leads the manner phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act of calling is established first, while the following participle regulates how the call is performed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the imperative clause primary and word 4 a circumstantial modifier rather than a separate finite command.

topics.headline: recipients become active callers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same audience moving from receiving signs and provision into performing the commanded call.
topics.reason: The implicit subject evidence keeps the plural addressees active, and the boundary rows connect this command to the preceding disclosure.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in accusative position; locally the explicit object of the command to invoke
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name and deity field with worship, refuge, awe, and authority pressures; locally the proper name fixes the unique invoked referent rather than a class noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the imperative that governs the divine name as object
the later pronoun phrase that resumes the divine referent

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) stands as the accusative object of {{ar:ٱدْعُوا۟}} ({{tr:udʿū}}), so the command is direct appeal to God, not speech about deity in general. The proper name fixes a unique referent before the participial manner phrase arrives, carrying worship-worthy authority and awe without turning the local form into a generic deity-class noun. The later pronoun in {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) routes dīn back to this same invoked one, so the addressee of the call and the owner of the order do not split. The same pure-dīn formula is expanded at 40:65 before the ayah's closing opposition appears.

topics.headline: the divine name receives the call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God is the direct object of invocation, not merely the topic of reverent mention.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence syntactically forces word 3 as the direct object of the imperative.

topics.headline: proper name blocks generic deity reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command addresses the named divine referent rather than a replaceable sacred category.
topics.reason: QAC marks a proper noun, and contextual evidence identifies the dominant referent as God.

topics.headline: worship and awe pressures serve the named referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the invoked name carries worship-worthy authority and awe, while local grammar still selects the proper-name object.
topics.reason: The derivational and deity-field pressures are meaningful, but the local surface is the proper divine name in object position.

topics.headline: the later pronoun returns dīn to the invoked one
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same referent governing both the call and the purified dīn phrase.
topics.reason: The prepositional pronoun in word 5 is governed in the exclusivity phrase and contextually resumes the divine object named in word 3.

topics.headline: the name anchors formula and contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name links the call to pure dīn formulae (40:65) before opposition appears at the close.
topics.reason: The contextual profiles support dense pairing of the divine-name field with dīn and purity language, and the CRITICAL rows identify 40:65 as the same-surah reprise.

topics.headline: referent is fixed before manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the call's addressee is fixed before the ayah specifies the callers' exclusive state.
topics.reason: The direct object precedes the circumstantial participle in the local clause.

words.gloss_range: active participle masculine plural accusative functioning as a circumstantial state; locally making dīn exclusive for God while calling
words.root_gloss_range: purity, separation, exclusive assignment, and selectedness branches; locally the pure-devotion branch is active, with extraction and reserve images as qualifying pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the command whose manner is supplied by the participle
the domain governed by the active participle

words.prose: {{ar:مُخْلِصِينَ}} ({{tr:mukhliṣīna}}) is not a second imperative; it is the accusative circumstantial state in which the plural callers perform {{ar:ٱدْعُوا۟}} ({{tr:udʿū}}). The active participle makes exclusivity ongoing and agentive: the call is made while dīn is being cleared for God. The root {{ar:خ ل ص}} ({{tr:kh-l-ṣ}}) supplies separation from mixture and exclusive assignment; reserve or extraction images sharpen the action, but the local object {{ar:ٱلدِّينَ}} ({{tr:al-dīna}}) keeps pure devotion as the selected branch. The phrase turns receptive return into outward purified calling, belongs with the explicit pure-dīn statement (39:3), and returns in the same shape at 40:65.

topics.headline: participle gives the command its manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sincerity is not delayed as another command but is the state in which calling is performed.
topics.reason: QAC marks an active participle in accusative form, and attachment evidence strongly licenses it as circumstantial to the imperative.

topics.headline: exclusive devotion is active and ongoing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sincerity as active clearing from mixture, not as a vague feeling attached to worship.
topics.reason: V4 preserves purification and pure-devotion branches for the root, and the local Form IV active participle makes the callers agents of that exclusivity.

topics.headline: extraction and reserve images sharpen pure dīn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the image of clearing or reserving dīn for God, while unrelated escape or companionship branches stay outside the local sense.
topics.reason: The broader root includes extraction, reserve, escape, and companionship branches, but the local participle governs dīn and is completed by the divine prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: purity and dīn form a concentrated formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording belongs to the Quranic pure-dīn pattern, including the same-surah reprise at 40:65 and the explicit pure-dīn statement at 39:3.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence supports the purity-root plus dīn pairing, and the CRITICAL rows give concrete formula references at 39:3 and 40:65.

topics.headline: one phrase joins call, owner, and domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that imperative, manner, owner, and dīn become one act of exclusive invocation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the participle to the imperative, the pronoun to the participle, and dīn as the participle's object.

topics.headline: return becomes outward exclusive calling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse turn from receptive return into outwardly purified invocation.
topics.reason: The boundary rows are coherent with the local syntax, where the commanded call is immediately regulated by the purity participle.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus third-person masculine singular pronoun; locally fronted assignment of dīn to the invoked divine referent

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the invoked divine name resumed by the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) is the small hinge that keeps the clause from splitting. Its pronoun points back to {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}), and its fronted lām assigns the coming dīn to Him before the noun is even heard. The phrase can carry possession, direction, and purpose together: dīn is for Him, toward Him, and not audience-facing performance. This pronoun bridge makes the invoked object and the exclusive owner the same referent, while those who received signs and provision now direct worship and dīn back to God.

topics.headline: pronoun bridges call and dīn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dīn phrase belongs to the same God who was just invoked.
topics.reason: The pronoun in word 5 is governed by the lām and completes the participial exclusivity phrase, with local antecedent in the divine object.

topics.headline: lām assigns purpose and ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that devotion is oriented to God rather than performed for the audience or rival recipients.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is syntactically tied to the active participle, making it the local direction and assignment of exclusivity.

topics.headline: fronting restricts before naming dīn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the possessive restriction arriving before the domain, so dīn enters already marked as God's.
topics.reason: The local order places the prepositional pronoun before word 6, and attachment evidence connects both to the participle.

topics.headline: pronoun recurrence and fronting converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a compressed assignment in which pronoun, fronted lām, and definite dīn work as one exclusivity device.
topics.reason: The particle and pronoun are fused as one word and sit inside the compact middle phrase linking participle and dīn.

topics.headline: beneficiaries become assigners to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse reversal: those who received signs and provision now direct worship and dīn back to God.
topics.reason: The pronoun bridge is locally coherent with the preceding discourse and the same commanded audience.

words.gloss_range: definite abstract noun in accusative relation to the active participle; locally the whole known order or devotion-domain made exclusive for God
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes obedience, submission, reckoning, recompense, debt, and ordered authority; locally the dīn domain gathers obligation and accountability under exclusive assignment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the fronted pronoun phrase assigning dīn to God

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدِّينَ}} ({{tr:al-dīna}}) is the domain being purified and assigned: the fronted {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) has already marked it as for God, and the participle governs it as the object of exclusivity. Its definiteness and singular abstract form make this a whole known order, not scattered devotional options. The root {{ar:د ي ن}} ({{tr:d-y-n}}) brings obedience, submission, debt, judgment, and recompense into the background; locally those pressures are narrowed into the binding order made pure for God. The middle beat concentrates command, manner, recipient, and domain before opposition is conceded. That is why echoes with judgment language (1:4), pure dīn (39:3), and the same-surah formula (40:65) matter: the order may be hated, but it is carried forward into accountability rather than negotiated away.

topics.headline: dīn is the object-domain of exclusivity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dīn is not merely mentioned; it is the domain actively made exclusive for God.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses word 6 as the object governed by the active participle, with word 5 supplying the divine assignment.

topics.headline: the known order is total and bounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording gathers allegiance into one definite domain rather than pluralized religious options.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite abstract noun, and the CRITICAL rows coherently read the singular definite form as a bounded known domain.

topics.headline: debt, judgment, and obedience load the domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dīn is more than private sentiment: it carries owed order, obedience, and accountability while the local phrase selects the exclusive-devotion domain.
topics.reason: V4 includes obedience, reckoning, debt, and ordered-authority branches; the local definite noun under the purity participle gathers those pressures without making any one branch an isolated translation.

topics.headline: the middle phrase is the allegiance hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that command, manner, recipient, and domain concentrate in the ayah's middle before opposition is conceded.
topics.reason: The syntax places the dīn phrase at the end of the main command unit before the concession begins.

topics.headline: dīn links purity, judgment, and opposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices dīn resonating with judgment language (1:4), pure-dīn formulae (39:3; 40:65), and opposition to that order.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence supports pairings with purity and the divine-name field, and the CRITICAL rows supply concrete references at 1:4, 39:3, and 40:65.

topics.headline: purified dīn points toward accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the purified order will be hated by opponents but carried forward into accountability rather than negotiated away.
topics.reason: The concessive clause and the transfer-risk note for the aversion verb support opposition to the preceding command phrase, including the dīn domain.

words.gloss_range: prefixed conjunction attached to the concessive particle; locally it turns from the completed command unit to opposition as a conceded circumstance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following particle that forms the concessive pair

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not simply add an equal clause. Attached to {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}), it turns the already complete command-and-manner unit toward conceded opposition. The short written and audible particle pair works as one compact hinge. The result is a pivot: hatred is admitted as a circumstance, but not promoted into a coordinate verdict over the obligation.

topics.headline: wāw turns addition into concession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that opposition is introduced as conceded circumstance rather than as a second ruling beside the command.
topics.reason: QAC marks a conjunction attached to the concessive particle, and the clause evidence links the following condition to the main imperative.

topics.headline: opposition follows a complete command unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the social resistance arrives after command and purity have already been established.
topics.reason: The first clause ends with the dīn phrase, and the following concessive clause is downstream from it.

topics.headline: particle fusion makes the pivot compact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the short particle pair working as a single audible and written hinge into the concession.
topics.reason: The local surface places the conjunction directly on the concessive particle, matching the CRITICAL claim of a compact phrase shape.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle with concessive force after the conjunction; locally it scopes the aversion clause as an even-if condition under the command

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the aversion verb governed by the concessive particle
the delayed subject inside the concessive clause
the conjunction that activates the concessive use

words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) scopes the whole closing clause, {{ar:كَرِهَ}} ({{tr:kariha}}) through {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirūna}}). After {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}), it functions concessively rather than as a normal predictive condition: even if the deniers hate it, their hatred is grammatically downstream from the command. The ayah's movement is three-beat: commanded invocation, purified manner, then conceded opposition. The particle preserves the reality of resistance while stripping it of veto power.

topics.headline: law scopes the whole hatred clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both the aversion verb and its subject held inside one concessive frame.
topics.reason: The clause evidence identifies words 7 through 10 as a concessive condition linked to the imperative clause.

topics.headline: condition becomes concession, not prediction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle admits a hostile scenario without making it the normal future condition that controls obedience.
topics.reason: The particle can have conditional range, but after the conjunction and in this clause link it is locally constrained to concessive force.

topics.headline: resistance remains grammatically downstream
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that unbelieving hatred follows the established obligation rather than reopening it.
topics.reason: The local syntax subordinates the aversion clause to the preceding command unit.

topics.headline: command, manner, concession form three beats
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's movement from command to purified manner to conceded opposition.
topics.reason: The clause division and attachments support the sequential architecture described by the CRITICAL rows.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect verb of aversion; locally objectless inside a concessive clause, with the delayed plural subject following
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes aversion, unwilling hardship, coercion, severity, and rough resistance; locally Form I selects being averse, not making something hateful or coercing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the concessive particle pair containing the perfect verb

words.prose: {{ar:كَرِهَ}} ({{tr:kariha}}) puts aversion into the concession before naming its agents, so hatred itself lands before the deniers are identified. The verb is singular perfect in a verb-initial pattern, and inside {{ar:وَلَوْ}} ({{tr:wa-law}}) it packages opposition as already conceded rather than as a live negotiation. No object is overt, so the hated target is compressed from the preceding command: the call, the purification, dīn, and the whole divine claim can be felt together. The root {{ar:ك ر ه}} ({{tr:k-r-h}}) ranges toward compulsion and rough resistance, but the local Form I verb names hostile aversion, not a causative act of making dīn hateful. The formula echoes opposition to God's light (61:8) while applying here to exclusive invocation and dīn, setting hostile aversion against active purification without giving hatred control over the command.

topics.headline: aversion lands before its agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hatred itself hitting the ear before the deniers are identified as its subject.
topics.reason: QAC marks a third masculine singular perfect verb, and attachment evidence makes word 10 the delayed subject.

topics.headline: object gap lets the whole command be hated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices aversion aimed at the preceding call, purity, dīn, and divine claim without the ayah listing them again.
topics.reason: The verb frame marks no overt object even though the verb can take one, and translation support warns against over-supplying a single target.

topics.headline: hostile dislike, not causative coercion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices resistant aversion while local form prevents reading the deniers as agents who compel or make dīn hateful.
topics.reason: V4 includes aversion and coercion branches, but the local surface is Form I perfect aversion, not a causative coercive form.

topics.headline: perfect form packages opposition as conceded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hatred treated as already conceded inside the even-if frame, not as a live negotiation over the command.
topics.reason: The perfect verb sits inside the concessive clause linked to the already established imperative.

topics.headline: aversion joins light and dīn opposition formulae
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same aversion formula used in opposition to God's light (61:8) now applied to exclusive invocation and dīn.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite 61:8 and related dīn opposition contexts, and the local clause has the same concession-plus-aversion shape.

topics.headline: opposition is vivid but contained
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the close contrast between active purification and hostile aversion, with concession preventing hatred from ruling the command.
topics.reason: The aversion verb is inside the concessive clause after the purity phrase, making opposition vivid at the close but structurally subordinate.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural active participle in nominative subject position; locally the known class of deniers assigned the conceded hatred
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes covering, concealment, ingratitude, rejection, disavowal, seed-covering, and expiation-covering; locally the active participle selects truth-covering denial and ingratitude

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the aversion verb whose subject is the final participle
the earlier participial class contrasted with the final subject

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirūna}}) finally names the subject of {{ar:كَرِهَ}} ({{tr:kariha}}), assigning aversion to a definite class rather than leaving it impersonal. The nominative active participle makes the haters a standing class of coverers, not a single past event, and the cadence answers the earlier participial class in {{ar:مُخْلِصِينَ}} ({{tr:mukhliṣīna}}): purifiers in the command, coverers in the concession. The root {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) preserves the covering image: after signs and provision have been disclosed, their denial is concealment and ingratitude, sharpened by the seed-covering image in 57:20 and the liability-covering contrast without replacing the local moral sense. The class continues earlier same-surah refusal (40:10; 40:12), formulaic hatred contexts (61:8; 9:32), and later opposition in the surah (40:25; 40:50; 40:74; 40:85). They close the ayah acoustically, but because they stand inside the concession, their opposition is last without being decisive and is carried forward toward accountability rather than debated here.

topics.headline: the deniers are the named subject of aversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices aversion assigned to a specific subject class rather than left impersonal.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence syntactically forces word 10 as the delayed subject of the aversion verb.

topics.headline: participle names a standing opposition class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices denial as an ongoing active identity, not only a past refusal.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an active participle masculine plural nominative, and the definite form coherently marks a known opposition class.

topics.headline: recognizable opponents lack veto power
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the class is recognizable and final in sound, yet still grammatically contained by the concession.
topics.reason: The subject appears inside the concessive clause linked downstream from the imperative.

topics.headline: covering image becomes active denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices disbelief as active covering and ingratitude after disclosure, while seed-covering and expiation remain supporting images rather than local senses.
topics.reason: V4 includes many covering branches, but the local active participle in an opposition clause selects the truth-rejecting and favor-covering branch.

topics.headline: seed-covering and expiation images sharpen contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the physical image of covering seed (57:20) and the liability-covering contrast as concrete background for moral denial.
topics.reason: Seed-covering and expiation-covering are real root branches, but the local surface names deniers rather than farmers or expiation.

topics.headline: the class continues Quranic opposition threads
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this final class linked to earlier same-surah refusal (40:10; 40:12), formulaic hatred contexts (61:8; 9:32), and later surah-local opposition (40:25; 40:50; 40:74; 40:85).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah and cross-surah references, and contextual evidence supports the k-f-r opposition class as a recurring field.

topics.headline: purifiers and coverers answer each other
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two active identities framing the ayah: purifiers in the command and coverers in the concession.
topics.reason: Both word 4 and word 10 are active participial plural forms, but their clauses place purification in the command and covering aversion in the concession.

topics.headline: opposition moves toward exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opposition class is not debated at the close but carried forward toward exposure and accountability.
topics.reason: The local final word is part of the same opposition vocabulary and remains contained by the concessive frame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural imperative فَٱدْعُوا۟, the circumstantial مُخْلِصِينَ, and the concessive وَلَوْ كَرِهَ form one directed action in 40:14.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling inclines speech toward the worshiped addressee; purification removes admixture from the obedience being offered; the concessive clause keeps that direction independent of hostile approval.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech supplies the commanded outward act and its direction.
The worshiped object fixes Allah, rather than a generic beneficiary, as the call's exclusive destination.
Purity after mixture supplies an active filtering of the offered allegiance.
Obedience and submission identify what is being filtered and directed.
Aversion supplies the resistant social pressure across which the action persists.
Denial and obstruction identify the opposition as resistance to the disclosed truth.

changed_reading.before: Call upon Allah sincerely even if disbelievers dislike it.
changed_reading.after: Direct practiced obedience to Allah by continually filtering out every admixture, while treating the deniers' aversion as pressure that cannot set the direction of worship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُخْلِصِينَ, ٱلدِّينَ, and كَرِهَ in 40:14 carry escape, subjection, and coercion branches alongside their ordinary senses.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call becomes an act of extracting allegiance from an entangling or coercive ownership structure: one escapes what has caught the self, removes imposed mastery from dīn, and speaks despite another party's will.

activation_trace.role: Escape from something in which one is caught supplies liberation rather than only inward sincerity.
Subjection, mastery, and being made to bear the disliked supply the allegiance structure from which purification extracts the worshiper.
Compelling another to what is disliked makes social coercion the counterforce to exclusive allegiance.
The voiced call makes the extraction public and directional rather than merely interior.

changed_reading.before: Be inwardly sincere in religion despite dislike.
changed_reading.after: Use the call to pull allegiance free of coercive ownership and redirect it wholly to Allah, even while the former claimants resist.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The financial-debt branch of ٱلدِّينَ is directly governed by the purifying circumstantial construction in 40:14.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dīn can image an outstanding liability, while calling can voice a right-claim or affiliation and purification can make something exclusive; together they suggest presenting the account to its sole creditor without rival claims.

activation_trace.role: Financial debt and deferred obligation supply the account or liability being acknowledged.
Claiming a right or affiliation makes the invocation legible as declaring where the claim belongs.
Exclusive allocation removes competing creditors or beneficiaries from the account.
The worshiped addressee identifies Allah as the sole holder of the obligation.

changed_reading.after: Acknowledge and clear the obligation exclusively before Allah, voicing no rival title over the account of obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior sequence says the audience rejects when Allah alone is called yet believes when partners are joined; 40:14 reverses that conditioned response by ordering a call whose dīn has been decontaminated of partnership.

activation_trace.role: Purification after admixture anchors the reversal as removal of the joined element.
Being called toward faith supplies the summons that the later imperative answers.
Repeated denial brackets the scene and exposes the audience's established response to that summons.
Calling Allah supplies the first side of the immediately preceding conditional reversal.
Divine oneness without partner specifies what the audience rejects.
Denial is the audience's response when the call is unmixed.
Association with Allah supplies the admixture to which the audience perversely responds with belief.

structural_cues: 40:10 first presents a call to faith answered by denial.
40:12 places the alone-versus-associated conditional only two ayat before the focus command.
The focus begins with فَ and repeats both the calling and denial roots.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mirrored response pattern and close repetition; I infer that 40:14 retrains that response by reversing its direction. A live alternative is that 40:12 merely indicts the audience while 40:14 independently addresses believers.

changed_reading.before: Invoke Allah with sincere religion despite opposition.
changed_reading.after: Reverse the learned attraction to association: answer the summons by calling Allah precisely alone, filtering from dīn the mixture that had made belief socially acceptable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah moves from signs shown and provision delivered from above to the one who repeatedly turns back; the focus's initial فَ makes invocation the answering return to what has arrived.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech anchors the response in the focus imperative.
Delivery from above supplies an antecedent gift to which the call can respond.
Apportioned giving makes the delivered object a benefaction rather than bare evidence.
Habitual return supplies the human motion that the ensuing invocation performs.

structural_cues: 40:13 immediately precedes 40:14.
The focus opens with a consequential فَ after the sign-provision-return sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, delivery, provision, return, and the initial connective; I infer the arrow gift and sign to returning call. A live alternative is a looser sequence in which فَ resumes exhortation without marking reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: Call upon Allah as a standalone devotional command.
changed_reading.after: Return the signs and apportioned provision as an unmixed answering call to their giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The debt branch of dīn is sustained by a surah-level ledger: every self is repaid for what it earned, the account is swift, and Allah adjudicates in truth while rival invocations adjudicate nothing. Purifying dīn therefore clears both liability and jurisdiction for one court.

activation_trace.role: Financial debt supplies the outstanding liability that the context turns into a full account.
Exclusive allocation removes competing claimants and jurisdictions from that liability.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies settlement of the account.
Acquisition and earning supply the entries on which recompense operates.
Counting and accounting make the financial image explicit.
Decisive judgment contrasts Allah's jurisdiction with the incapacity of those called besides Him.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the standard by which the account is adjudicated.

structural_cues: 40:17 clusters recompense, earning, and account immediately after the focus.
40:20 repeats judgment for Allah and negates it for the beings invoked besides Him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies debt, earning, recompense, account, and exclusive judgment; I infer that devotional exclusivity also functions as exclusive liability and jurisdiction. The live alternative is that dīn remains obedience while the accounting vocabulary only describes its later consequence.

changed_reading.after: Bring the earned account under Allah's sole claim and court, clearing the debt of obedience from every rival creditor or judge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh treats dīn as a possessive public order that Moses might replace and dismissively allows Moses to call his Lord. Against that scene, purifying dīn for Allah extracts allegiance from a regime's claimed ownership and refuses its definition of corruption.

activation_trace.role: Escape from entanglement anchors exclusive worship as extraction from a captured order.
Mastery and imposed subjection make political ownership of allegiance a live focus-side pressure.
Moses being told to call his Lord places invocation inside the sovereign conflict.
One thing standing in place of another supplies Pharaoh's feared replacement of the order.
Established habit and customary order explain the possessive 'your dīn' that Pharaoh claims to defend.
Public emergence makes the feared change social and visible rather than private.
Departure from an order's claimed soundness supplies the regime's accusation against changed allegiance.

structural_cues: 40:26 puts calling one's Lord and changing 'your dīn' in the same royal speech.
The focus directs dīn 'for Him,' whereas Pharaoh grammatically assigns dīn to the governed audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Pharaoh's possessive order, feared replacement, public corruption charge, and Moses's call; I infer the arrow exclusive invocation to counter-sovereign extraction. A live alternative is that Pharaoh's speech only reports tyrannical fear and does not define a political function for the focus command.

changed_reading.before: Maintain private sincerity despite hostile dislike.
changed_reading.after: Publicly relocate allegiance from the regime's claimed order to Allah, refusing the coercive sovereign's right to name that relocation corruption.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believing speaker and his people issue reciprocal calls toward opposed destinations, salvation and fire; one call joins partners without knowledge and lacks valid standing, while the other ends by entrusting the outcome to Allah. The focus call is thus participation in a public contest of summons, not only private petition.

activation_trace.role: Calling and verbally inclining supplies the focus act that the later dialogue expands into reciprocal invitation.
Exclusive allocation anchors the criterion separating the rival summons.
The two opposed calls make invitation explicitly reciprocal and directional.
Escape by separation supplies the destination promised by the believer's call.
Repeated call versus counter-call carries the contest from destination into allegiance.
Association with Allah identifies the admixture demanded by the counter-summons.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies the evidentiary test that the counter-summons fails.
The claim and affiliation branch gives the denied daʿwa the sense of lacking a valid claim or standing in either world.
Returning the matter to another in trust supplies the believer's non-coercive handling of the contest's outcome.

structural_cues: 40:41-43 repeats second-person and first-person forms of the same calling root.
The opposed destinations and allegiances are arranged as direct verbal exchanges.
40:44 closes the speech by entrusting the matter rather than forcing the hearers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal calls, opposed destinations, knowledge asymmetry, denied standing, and entrustment; I infer that the focus imperative authorizes a public counter-summons. A live alternative is that later daʿwa is exemplary preaching while 40:14 remains specifically prayer.

changed_reading.after: Enter the public field of rival invitations with an unmixed call toward rescue, expose the partner-call's lack of knowledge and standing, then entrust rather than coerce the outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those already in the fire ask its keepers to call for one day's relief and are told to call, but the call of the deniers is lost. This creates a temporal asymmetry: the focus commands an unmixed call while aversion can still be crossed, before judgment fixes the caller's condition.

activation_trace.role: The present imperative anchors the timely call whose later counterpart fails.
Denial identifies the hostile audience now and the disabled callers later.
The condemned ask intermediaries to call, supplying a belated and displaced invocation.
Lightening a burden specifies the minimal relief sought after closure.
The command to call followed by evaluation of their call turns repetition into an efficacy test.
Entrenched denial, not mere wording, marks the callers whose prayer cannot find its way.
Deviation from the intended destination supplies the call's terminal lostness.

structural_cues: 40:49-50 forms a request, delegated call, renewed imperative, and verdict in immediate sequence.
The focus and 40:50 share both the calling and denying roots.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present command and later futile calling after judgment; I infer an open-time to closed-time arrow. A live alternative is that efficacy differs solely by the callers' denying status, not by temporal closure.

changed_reading.before: Call Allah even though deniers dislike the act.
changed_reading.after: Call Allah directly and with purified allegiance now, before aversion hardens into the condition in which even a desperate call for the smallest relief is directionless.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command pairs calling with divine answer and names refusal as arrogance toward worship; a second speech forbids worship of those called besides Allah and commands surrender. The three fields triangulate focus-side dīn as responsive worshipful submission.

activation_trace.role: The focus call supplies the act later placed inside an answer relation.
Obedience and submission anchor prayer as enacted worship rather than detached request.
The direct command 'call Me' repeats and personalizes the focus imperative.
Returning speech with an answer supplies reciprocity rather than one-way utterance.
Self-magnification supplies the posture that blocks the call.
Humble worship and obedience identify the relation from which arrogance withdraws.
Prohibition supplies the negative boundary around worshipful calling.
Worshipful obedience is explicitly attached to the objects that must be refused.
Calling those objects links invocation directly to the forbidden worship relation.
Other-than-Allah supplies the rival destination excluded by purification.
Handing over and relinquishing supplies the commanded positive posture toward the Lord of the worlds.

structural_cues: 40:60 places call, answer, arrogance, and worship in one sentence.
40:66 places forbidden worship, rival calling, command, and surrender in one first-person declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tight lexical juxtapositions among call, answer, worship, refusal, and surrender; I infer functional overlap rather than strict dictionary identity. A live alternative is that calling is one practice within worship, not a synonym for all worship.

changed_reading.after: Enter an answering relation by enacting humble surrender itself: to call is to worshipfully hand over allegiance, while refusal is self-magnifying withdrawal from that relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: After night, day, favor, formed bodies, and good provision, 40:65 almost exactly reprises the focus command, now prefaced by divine life and followed by praise. The repeated formula becomes the return-path by which received life and provision are converted into exclusive gratitude.

activation_trace.role: The original command anchors the later wording as a reprise rather than a new unrelated act.
Recognizing a benefit and praising its giver states the response that many people withhold.
Apportioned giving supplies the concrete benefit answered by the repeated call.
Goodness opposed to corruption characterizes the provision as fit for grateful receipt.
Life as benefit and good frames the addressee as the living source of the preceding gifts.
The repeated call carries the earlier imperative into the benefaction sequence.
Repeated purification keeps gratitude from being distributed among imagined co-givers.
Repeated obedience makes gratitude a practiced order rather than a passing feeling.
Praise opposed to blame supplies the verbal return into which the invocation resolves.

structural_cues: 40:61-64 accumulates ordered benefits and explicitly notes failed gratitude.
40:65 repeats the focus's call-purification-dīn sequence in the same order.
The reprise adds divine life before the command and praise immediately after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a benefaction catalogue, failed gratitude, exact root-order reprise, life, and praise; I infer a gift to call to praise circuit. A live alternative is that 40:65 restates a doctrinal-liturgical formula without making provision the cause of invocation.

changed_reading.before: Repeat the command to invoke Allah exclusively.
changed_reading.after: Return received life, form, rhythm, and provision to their living giver through an unmixed call that matures into praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the surah's end, sight of force produces a confession of faith in Allah alone and disavowal of partners, but that confession no longer benefits. The coercion branch of focus-side aversion therefore sharpens a contrast between chosen exclusivity while opposition is live and compelled exclusivity after evidence becomes overwhelming.

activation_trace.role: Being made to do what one dislikes supplies the focus-side contrast between aversion endured and confession compelled.
Exclusive separation from partnership anchors what the final confession eventually says too late.
Direct sight supplies the overwhelming disclosure that changes the confessors' posture.
Overpowering force supplies the compulsion under which exclusivity is finally voiced.
Heart-settling assent supplies the claimed change in belief.
Oneness without partner makes the late confession lexically match the focus's exclusive direction.
Disavowal and renunciation supply the late separation from former partners.
Association with Allah identifies exactly what the late speakers renounce.
Benefit opposed to harm is explicitly denied to the late faith.
An established running way makes the loss a stable closure rule rather than an isolated accident.

structural_cues: 40:84 voices faith, divine oneness, and rejection of partnership only after force is seen.
40:85 immediately denies benefit to that faith and closes with the loss of the deniers.
The end sequence reverses the focus's choice to persist while deniers still dislike exclusivity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seen force, late exclusive confession, and denied benefit; I use the coercion branch of كره to infer a voluntary-versus-compelled contrast. A live alternative is that the final sequence marks only a deadline, without activating coercion inside 40:14.

changed_reading.after: Choose unmixed allegiance while aversion can still be borne freely; do not postpone exclusivity until force compels the same confession after it has lost efficacy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a devotional circumstantial phrase onto the later carceral material sequence. It remains anchored because خ ل ص explicitly carries escape from entanglement and dīn carries subjection, while 40:71 supplies literal neck-fetters, linked chains, and dragging. Render it only as an exploratory material analogy for allegiance hardening into bondage, not as a claim that 40:14 directly predicts those chains.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The escape-from-entanglement branch of مُخْلِصِينَ and the subjection branch of ٱلدِّينَ in 40:14.

activation_trace.role: Escape from a snare supplies the focus-side motion out of binding allegiance.
Subjection and imposed mastery supply the relation that can harden into bondage.
A collar that binds the limb gives the entanglement a literal constricting form.
Connected links supply the cumulative structure of bindings joined one to another.
Dragging and extending supplies the loss of self-directed movement once the binding closes.
Kindling and intensifying fire supplies the terminal environment into which the binding draws its subject.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, pull allegiance free while it is still disentanglable, before joined loyalties become a linked system that governs and drags the self.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the material image of milk deliberately left in the udder to draw what follows. It remains validly anchored in the focus root د ع و and is reinforced by the later call-answer pair and the exact 40:65 reprise. Downstream prose should label it a process analogy for a call that primes further response and praise, not a lexical replacement for prayer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The 'residual milk that calls what follows' branch of فَٱدْعُوا۟ in 40:14.

activation_trace.role: A retained remainder that draws subsequent flow supplies a priming rather than one-off model of invocation.
The repeated command reactivates the same priming image later in the surah.
Returned speech supplies the response drawn after the initiating call.
The exact reprise makes the initial call recur as a retained starter rather than disappear.
Praise supplies the further verbal flow that the repeated invocation draws out.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, leave an unmixed initiating call active within practice so that answer, renewed calling, and praise can be drawn after it.

strongest_changes: The immediate 40:10-12 reversal turns sincerity into active decontamination of a call from the partnership to which the audience had been conditioned.
The 40:41-50 and 40:60 sequences turn private petition into a contest of summons whose direction, worshipful posture, and timing determine whether it reaches an answer or is lost.
Pharaoh's threatened 'your dīn' and the judgment-account sequence make exclusive dīn simultaneously a counter-sovereign relocation of allegiance and an account owed to one jurisdiction.
The exact 40:65 reprise returns the command through life, provision, gratitude, and praise, giving the focus a whole-surah gift-response circuit.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly stages the same focus roots in changed relations: people are called and deny, rival groups call one another, late callers fail, Allah commands a call and promises response, and the full call-purification-dīn formula returns near the end. That recurrence supports several coexisting mechanisms instead of one flattened gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The financial-debt and coerced-extraction branches of dīn are strongly activated by the context but may remain secondary images rather than intended primary senses.
The exact 40:65 reprise may function as interpretive closure through gratitude, or more minimally as a renewed liturgical-doctrinal formula.
The direction from purified allegiance to efficacy of prayer is inferred from sequence and contrast; it is not stated as a formal causal rule.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Calling requires removal of admixture.** `خ ل ص/B001` gives purification into unmixed clarity, modifying the callers’ stance; `د ع و/B001` supplies the directed call. I infer that competing allegiances are the sediment being removed. The command reads not only as sincerity of feeling but as purification of the channel through which obligation and invocation move.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The near repetition in 40:65, now preceded by cosmic habitation and living exclusivity, confirms purification as removal of rival channels rather than private mood alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Pure devotion is anticipatory alignment with reckoning.** Lexically, `خ ل ص:B004` is "exclusive separation from sharing," while `د ي ن:B002` is "reckoning and recompense" as well as `B001` obedience. Structurally, 40:12 has just opposed divine oneness to partnership and assigned judgment to God; 40:15-17 immediately stage meeting, exposure, and matched payment. Purification removes rival claims from the relation that will be reckoned. The packet supplies exclusive calling beside the coming account; I infer that present obedience is being oriented toward that future settlement. `الدين` therefore carries an accounting pressure: worship is made unmixed because its allegiance will be adjudicated.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:65 repeats unmixed `الدين`, and 40:66 immediately renders it as commanded submission; this confirms that reckoning and lived obedience remain active together.

baseline.text: İnkâr edenler hoşlanmasa da kulluğu yalnız O'na özgü kılarak Allah'a dua edin.

findings.text: Kulluğu yalnız Allah'a özgü kılmak, çağrı kanalını rakip bağlılıkların karışımından arındırmaktır.
Arınmış kulluk, gelecekte hesaba çekilecek bağlılığı şimdiden tek bir yöne yerleştiren bir hazırlık niteliği taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ses ve söz yoluyla bir şeyi konuşana doğru yöneltmeyi temel anlam olarak verir; yemeğe çağırmayı ve bir yere yönelmeyi de bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlar olarak gösterir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel seslenme anlamı, yalnızca belirli yapılarda görülen yemeğe çağırma ve bir yere yönelme kullanımlarından ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın seslenme çekirdeğini kapsar; yemeğe çağırma ile belirli bir yere yönelme anlamları yalnızca kendi yapıları içinde geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Ses ve söz kullanarak birini ya da bir şeyi konuşana doğru yöneltmektir. Yemeğe çağırma ve bir yeri amaçlayıp oraya gitme, bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Ses ve söz, yöneltilen kişiyi ya da şeyi konuşana doğru çekmenin aracıdır.
Yemeğe çağırma, yöneltme çekirdeğinin belirli bir etkinliğe bağlı özel kullanımıdır.
Belirli bir yeri amaçlayıp oraya gitme, yerin kişiyi çağırdığı varsayımıyla anlatılan mecazlı bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak iddiası, ses ve sözle kendine yöneltme çekirdeğini; yemeğe çağırmayı ve bir yeri amaçlayarak oraya gitmeyi bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar halinde birlikte sunar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sesli ve sözlü bir çağrının hedefi konuşana ya da onun belirlediği yöne çektiği temel anlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ses ve söz aracını, yöneltme hareketini ve konuşana doğru oluşan yönü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye seslenip onu konuşana veya belirlenen yere yöneltme bağlamlarında doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Yemeğe çağırma ile yerin çağırdığı varsayımına dayanan yönelme uzantılarını tek başına göstermez.

error_profile.loses: Genel çağırma çekirdeğini ve yer yönelimi uzantısını kapsamaz.

error_profile.loses: Yerin kişiyi çağırdığı varsayımını ve genel seslenme çekirdeğini açıkça taşımaz.

error_profile.loses: Ses ve sözle kendine yöneltme çekirdeğini ve yer yönelimi uzantısını kapsamaz.
error_profile.adds: Türkçede toplumsal veya resmî bir etkinliğe çağırma çağrışımını öne çıkarabilir.
error_profile.collision: Yalın seslenme ile yapıya bağlı yemeğe çağırma anlamlarının sınırını belirsizleştirir.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kendisi veya başkası adına bir hak ya da aidiyet bağı ileri sürmesidir. Soy veya çocuk bağı kurma ve savaşta soyunu söyleyerek kendini tanıtma, bu iddia eyleminin özel biçimleridir.

facets.statement: Bir hak, kişinin kendisi ya da başka biri lehine ileri sürülür.
Bir çocuk veya kişi için soy bağı ileri sürülerek onu belirli bir babaya ya da soya bağlama anlamı vardır.
Savaş bağlamında kişi soyunu söyleyerek kendini ve bağlı olduğu topluluğu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu iddia, hak ileri sürme çekirdeği yanında soy veya çocuk bağı kurmayı ve savaşta soy bildirerek kendini tanıtmayı birbirinden ayrılan özel gerçekleşmeler olarak kapsar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الادعاء أن تدعي حقا لك أو لغيرك (maqayis)؛ الادعاء في الحرب الاعتزاء (maqayis)؛ الدعوة ادعاء الولد الدعي غير أبيه ويدعيه غير أبيه (ayn)؛ الدعوة في النسب بالكسر (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlamak amacıyla memede bilerek bırakılan süt miktarını açıkça tanımlar; hazırlanan dal çerçevesi bu amaç ve araç ilişkisini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca memede bırakılan sütün sonraki sütü çekmesi düşüncesine bağlıdır; genel süt kalıntısına yayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen sütçülük yapısına bağlıdır ve kökün yalın biçimine bağımsız bir anlam olarak aktarılamaz.

concept_map.definition: Sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlamak için sağım sırasında memede bilerek bırakılan süt payıdır.

facets.statement: Sağımda sütün bir bölümü memede bilerek bırakılır.
Bırakılan payın işlevi, ardından gelecek sütün akışını uyarmaktır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, memede süt bırakma işlemini ve bu işlemin sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlama amacını ayrılmaz biçimde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: sütün devamını çekmek için memede bırakılan pay
concept_gloss.applicability: Sağımda kalan sütün tesadüfi değil, sonraki sütün gelmesini uyarmak için bilerek bırakıldığı özel kavramı karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Süt payını, memede bırakılmasını ve sonraki sütü getirme amacını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sütçülük bağlamında, sonraki sütün akmasını sağlamak üzere memede bırakılan miktarı kısa biçimde anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Bırakılan payın sağımın devamını sağlama işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Payın özellikle memede bırakıldığını ve sonraki sütü çektiğini açıkça söylemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sonraki sütü çekmek için memede bırakılan süt payı

error_profile.preserves: Sağım sonrasında memede bir miktar süt bulunmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Sütün bilerek bırakılmasını ve sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlama amacını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Memede kalan sütün sonraki sütü getirmesi için bilerek bırakılmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Memede kalan sütün az ve yudumluk miktarda oluşunu anlatır; özel bir işlev şart koşmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da sağım sonrasında memede bulunan küçük bir süt miktarını konu eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kalanın amacıyla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise miktarın azlığıyla tanımlanır ve sonraki sütü çekme işlevini gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Süt akışını uyarmak için memede bırakılan sütün kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Memeyi sıvazlayarak sütü indirme eylemini ve bu yolla süt veren hayvanı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da memeden yeni süt akışını başlatma veya sürdürme amacı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uyarıcı araç memede bırakılan süt payıdır; komşuda araç memenin sıvazlanmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir miktar sütü sonraki akışı sağlamak üzere memede bırakmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Parmak uçlarıyla az az sağmayı, yavaş akışı ve kalan sütü çekip almayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da memedeki az miktardaki süt ve sağımın sürdürülmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sütü bırakır ve işlevini bekler; komşu dal az miktardaki sütü belirli bir sağım biçimiyle dışarı alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi. Seçilen komşular, amaçlı bırakılan süt payını az süt kalıntısından, memeyi sıvazlamaktan ve az az sağmaktan ayırır; öteki adaylar sağımın başka aşamalarına veya kardeş anlamlara aittir.
branches.what_is_ar: ما يترك في الضرع من اللبن ليدعو ما بعده
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس دعوة الطعام ولا دعوة النسب ولا دعاء الصوت العام
branches.source_phrase_ar: داعية اللبن ما يترك في الضرع ليدعو ما بعده

identity_judgment.rationale: Hazırlanan çerçeve bunu birine kötülük gelmesi için söz söyleme olarak sunarken kaynak ifadesi, Tanrı'nın kişinin başına hoşlanmadığı şeyi getirmesini ve olayın gerçekleşmesini anlatır. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım sözlü dilekten gerçekleşen sıkıntıya kaydırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, belirli yapıda Tanrı'nın istenmeyen bir şeyi kişinin başına getirmesidir; kötülük dileme eylemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Düzeltilen anlam yalnızca verilen Tanrı, kişi ve istenmeyen sonuç yapısında geçerlidir; yalın çağırma anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapıda, Tanrı'nın bir kişinin başına onun hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntıyı getirmesini anlatır. Odak, birinin kötülük dilemesi değil, istenmeyen olayın kişiye yönelip gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Tanrı, kişiye onun hoşlanmadığı bir şeyi yöneltir ve başına getirir.
Kaynak açıklaması sözlü bir kötülük isteğini değil, istenmeyen sonucun kişide gerçekleşmesini öne çıkarır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak iddiası, Tanrı'nın bir kişiye hoşlanmadığı şeyi indirmesi veya başına getirmesi sonucunu bildirir; sözlü bir kötülük dileme işlemi belirtmez.

concept_gloss.text: Tanrı'nın birine istemediği bir sıkıntıyı vermesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Tanrı'nın bir kişinin başına o kişinin hoşlanmadığı bir olay veya sıkıntı getirdiğini bildiren özel yapı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eyleyenin Tanrı olmasını, etkilenen kişiyi ve onun istemediği sonucun gerçekleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eyleyeni geri planda bırakıp kişi açısından gerçekleşen istenmeyen sonucu anlatmak gerektiğinde kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin başına hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntının gelmesi sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Sonucu Tanrı'nın meydana getirdiğini açıkça belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı'nın birinin başına hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntıyı getirmesi

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişiye yönelen istenmeyen sonuç düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaynakta bildirilen gerçekleşmiş ilahi yöneltme ve meydana gelme ilişkisini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Bir insanın sözlü istekte bulunduğu ayrı bir konuşma eylemi ekler.
error_profile.collision: Sonucun gerçekleşmesini, o sonucun gerçekleşmesini isteme eylemiyle karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tanrı'nın istenmeyen şeyi kişinin başına getirmesi ve sonucun gerçekleşmesi anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişinin başkasına kötülük yönelten söz söylemesi öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirli bir kişinin başına kötü bir şey gelmesi düşüncesini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gerçekleşen ilahi yöneltmeyi bildirir; komşu dal ise kötü sonucun gerçekleşmesi için söylenen sözü anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İstenmeyen sonucun Tanrı tarafından kişiye verilmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Lanetleme ve karşılıklı olarak yalancının cezalandırılmasını isteme törenlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da Tanrı ile ilişkilendirilen kötü bir sonucun kişiye yönelmesi sahnesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sonuç bildiren özel bir yapıdır; komşu dal sözlü lanetleme veya karşılıklı sınama eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sıkıntının belirli bir eyleyen tarafından kişiye getirilmesi ilişkisini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sıkıntı, zarar veya güçlüğün kendisini ve onun yoğunluğunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin yaşadığı hoş olmayan ve zarar verici durumu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sıkıntının kişiye yöneltilmesini anlatır; komşu dal yönelten bir eyleyen gerektirmeden sıkıntı durumunu adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı. Seçilenler gerçekleşen sıkıntıyı kötülük dileme, lanetleme ve sıkıntının kendisinden ayırır; kalanlar uzak sonuç türleri veya bu kökün başka dallarıdır.
branches.what_is_ar: إنزال المكروه بأحد في قولهم دعا الله فلانا بما يكره
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس دعاء العبادة ولا الدعوة إلى الطعام ولا ادعاء النسب
branches.source_phrase_ar: دعا الله فلانا بما يكره أي أنزل به ذلك

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı süreci açıkça verir: duvarların birbiri ardından çökmesi ve yapıların birbiri ardından yıkılması. Hazırlanan çerçeve, ardışıklığı ve çökme ile ettirgen yıkma ayrımını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Birbiri ardından gerçekleşme her iki kullanımda da kurucudur; tek bir çökme veya tek seferde yıkma dalın tamamını karşılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kendiliğinden ardışık çöküş ile bir eyleyenin ardışık yıkması ayrı yapılara bağlı iki facet olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yapının parçalarının birbiri ardından çökmesi veya bir eyleyenin onları birbiri ardından yıkmasıdır. Her iki durumda da tek olay değil, birbirini izleyen bir bozulma dizisi vardır.

facets.statement: Yapısal bozulma tek seferde değil, parçaların birbirini izlemesiyle gerçekleşir.
Duvarlar veya yapı parçaları kendiliğinden birbiri ardından çöker.
Bir eyleyen, yapı parçalarını hedefin üzerine birbiri ardından yıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, ardışık çöküşü ve ardışık ettirgen yıkmayı aynı sıra ilişkisi altında birleştirir; eyleyenin bulunup bulunmaması iki kullanımı ayırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem yapı parçalarının sırayla çökmesini hem de bir eyleyenin onları sırayla yıkmasını kapsayan üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ardışıklığı, yapısal bozulmayı ve kendiliğinden çökme ile ettirgen yıkma seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Duvar veya yapı parçalarının kendiliğinden ve sırayla düştüğü kullanım için doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapı parçalarının ardışık biçimde çökmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir eyleyenin parçaları birbiri ardından yıkması kullanımını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir eyleyenin yapı parçalarını hedefin üzerine sırayla yıktığı kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen yıkmayı ve parçaların sıra ile devrilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yapının kendiliğinden ardışık çökmesi kullanımını kapsamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Yapının ayakta kalma durumunu yitirerek düşmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Parçaların birbiri ardından gelmesini ve ettirgen yıkma kullanımını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çöküşün veya yıkmanın parçalar arasında sıra halinde ilerlemesini ve ettirgen seçeneği kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin genel olarak düşmesi veya yıkılmasını, ayrıca ağacın kökünden çıkmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir yapının ayakta kalma durumunu yitirip çökmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal için ardışıklık kurucudur; komşu dal tek bir çöküşü de kapsar ve sıra ilişkisi gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birbiri ardından çökme veya yıkma düzenini vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yıkılmanın taşıyıcı düzeni, gücü veya itibarı ortadan kaldıran sonucunu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yapıların yıkılması ve ayakta tutan düzenin bozulması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal olayların sırasıyla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise yıkımın dayanıklılığı ve düzeni yok eden sonucuyla tanımlanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birden çok parçanın birbirini izleyerek çökmesini veya yıkılmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir yapının ya da kenarın yüksekten aşağıya veya çukura doğru çöküş yönünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yapı parçalarının düşmesi ve bütünlüğün bozulması olayını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı özelliği ardışık sıra, komşunun ayırıcı özelliği ise aşağıya veya derine doğru çöküş yönüdür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi. Yayınlanan komşular ardışıklık sınırını genel çökme, sonucu öne çıkan yıkım ve aşağı yönlü çöküşten ayırır; kalan adaylar kırma, zayıflama, düzleme veya kardeş anlam alanlarında daha uzaktır.
branches.what_is_ar: سقوط بعض الشيء إثر بعض وهدمه واحدا بعد آخر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس النداء بالكلام ولا ادعاء الحق ولا دعوة الطعام
branches.source_phrase_ar: تداعت الحيطان وذلك إذا سقط واحد وآخر بعده؛ داعيناها عليهم إذا هدمناها واحدا بعد آخر

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dönemin değişimlerini ve olayların yönünü değiştirmelerini anlatır. Hazırlanan çerçevenin olaylar ve yön verme bölümü uygundur, ancak insanın bu olaylara eğilmesi kaynakta kurucu bir katılımcı olarak açıkça verilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım, insanın yönelmesini değil, dönemin olayların akışını başka yöne çeviren değişimlerini merkeze alır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca dönemin yön verici değişimleri yapısına bağlıdır; yalın biçime genel bir olay veya çağırma anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Dönemin olayların akışını başka yöne çeviren değişimleri ve getirdiği gelişmelerdir. Yöneltme düşüncesi burada sesli bir çağrı değil, olayların seyrine etki eden mecazlı bir güçtür.

facets.statement: Dönem, değişen koşullar ve gelişmeler yoluyla olayların akışına yön verir.
Olayların başka yöne çevrilmesi, temel yöneltme ilişkisini zamansal değişimlere taşıyan mecazlı bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, dönemin değişimlerini olayların yönünü etkileyen güçler olarak sunar; insanın bu değişimlere çekilmesi kaynak ifadesinde zorunlu bir öğe değildir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dönemin getirdiği değişimlerin olayların seyrini etkilediğini anlatan özel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dönemin değişimlerini, olayları ve bu değişimlerin yön verici etkisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yön verme benzetisini açmadan, dönem içinde meydana gelen değişim ve gelişmeleri doğal Türkçeyle anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Dönemin değişkenliğini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan olayları korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu değişimlerin olayların yönünü çevirdiği mecazlı ilişkiyi açıkça göstermez.

error_profile.preserves: Olayların yön verici bir etkisi olduğu düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dönemin değişimleri ile olayların seyrinin yön değiştirmesi arasındaki bağı zayıflatır.
error_profile.adds: Kaynakta kurucu olmayan insan katılımcısını ve onun edilgin biçimde sürüklenmesini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Olayların yönünün değişmesi ile insanın olaylara kapılması birbirine karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dönemin değişimlerini olayların yönünü etkileyen bir güç olarak kavramlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dönemin insanlar üzerinde gerçekleşen türlü olaylarını ve bazı kullanımlarda gece ile gündüzü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da dönem içinde ortaya çıkan değişimleri ve olayların değişken seyrini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yön verme benzetisiyle sınırlıdır; komşu dal daha genel olayları ve daha geniş zamansal kullanımları kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Değişimleri, olumlu veya olumsuz değer yüklemeden olayların yönünü değiştirmeleri bakımından ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Beklenen veya korkulan uğursuz gelişmeler ve belirsizlik duygusunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da dönemin getirdiği değişimleri ve beklenmedik gelişmeleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel yön değişimini anlatır; komşu dal değişimlerin kaygı, kuşku ve kötü beklenti doğuran yönüyle sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü karşılaştırıldı. İki yakın komşu, yön verici dönem değişimini genel dönem olaylarından ve kaygı uyandıran gelişmelerden ayırır; diğer adaylar ölüm, insanın durumu, yaklaşan sonuç veya kardeş anlamlarla daha dolaylı ilişkilidir.
branches.what_is_ar: صروف الدهر وحوادثه التي تميل الإنسان إليها
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس دعاء الصوت ولا ادعاء النسب ولا تداعي الحيطان
branches.source_phrase_ar: دواعي الدهر صروفه كأنها تميل الحوادث

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, gizlenmiş cevabı ortaya çıkarmak için karşılıklı olarak sorulan bilmece türü soruları ve birine böyle bir soru yöneltme eylemini birlikte verir. Hazırlanan çerçeve bu soru, gizleme ve cevap çıkarma ilişkisini korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sıradan anlaşılmaz sözü değil, gizlenmiş bir cevabı buldurmak üzere yöneltilen bilmece ve sınama eylemini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bilmece olarak kullanılan adlandırma ile birine bilmece yöneltme eylemi ayrı facetlerde korunur; anlam genel seslenmeye yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gizlenmiş bir cevabı ortaya çıkarmak için birine yöneltilen bilmece türü soru veya böyle sorularla karşılıklı sınamadır. Soru, muhatabı örtülü cevabı bulup söylemeye çağırır.

facets.statement: Soru, cevabı doğrudan vermeyip onu örtülü ve çözülmesi gereken halde sunar.
Kişiler bu tür soruları birbirlerine yönelterek karşılıklı bir sınama yürütür.
Eylem biçimi, muhataba bir bilmece sunup gizli cevabı ondan istemeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, bilmece niteliğindeki örtülü soruyu, bu sorularla karşılıklı sınamayı ve muhataptan gizli cevabı çıkarma amacını birlikte temellendirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Örtülü bir cevabı ortaya çıkarmak için kişilerin birbirine bilmece türü soru yönelttiği kavramı karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Gizli cevabı, onu buldurma amacını, bilmece biçimini ve karşılıklı sınamayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin muhatabına örtülü cevabı bulması için soru yönelttiği eylem bağlamında doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Birine çözülmesi gereken örtülü bir soru yöneltme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Soruların karşılıklı yürütülmesini ve cevabı özellikle ortaya çıkarma benzetisini tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişilerin birbirine örtülü sorular yönelterek cevap verme gücünü denediği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklılığı, bilmece biçimini ve sınama işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Gizlenmiş cevabı muhataptan ortaya çıkarma yönünü açıkça söylemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli bir ev yapısında hiç kimsenin bulunmadığını, seslenebilecek tek bir kişinin bile olmaması üzerinden açıklar. Hazırlanan dal çerçevesi hem yokluk sonucunu hem de ses veren kimse benzetisini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yalnızca evde insan yokluğudur; komşu dal yer sınırını genişletir ve insan dışında belirti yokluğuna da uzanabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi itme eyleminde birleşir; ancak sertlik, kabalık ve azarlama niteliği bütün aktarımlarda aynı ölçüde kurucu değildir. Bu yüzden dal, sıradan itme çekirdeğini koruyup sert ve kaba gerçekleşmeleri belirgin kullanımlar olarak ayırmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek fiziksel itmedir; sertlik ve azarlama bazı kullanımları daraltır, doldurma veya seslenme anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak itme çekirdeğiyle yapıya bağlı sertçe sürme ve azarlama örneklerini ayırır; özel yapılar bütün dalın anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Birini ya da bir şeyi itmek; belirli kullanımlarda bunu sertçe, kaba davranarak veya azarlayıcı biçimde yapmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir varlığı bulunduğu yerden fiziksel güçle itme eylemidir.
Eylem sertlik, kabalık ve azarlama eşliğinde gerçekleşebilir.
Bazı yapılarda savunmasız birini itip azarlamayı veya bir yere zorla sürmeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar itme çekirdeğinde birleşir; bir bölümü eylemin sert, kaba ve azarlayıcı niteliğini ayrıca öne çıkarır.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel güçle yerinden oynatma çekirdeğini tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin belirli bir yöne veya yere şiddetle sevk edildiği yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.adds: Temasın sürmesi ve nesnenin çekilmesi anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Türkçede çekerek ilerletme eylemiyle karışır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, bir ölçek kabını veya başka bir taşıyıcıyı hareket ettirerek içindekini yerleştirme ve kabı dolu ya da sıkışık duruma getirme sürecini açıkça destekler. Sonuç bildiren doldurma kullanımları aynı işlemin doğal uzantısıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ayırıcı özellik yalnızca doluluk değil, kabı hareket ettirerek kapasitesini kullanma veya içeriği sıkıştırma sürecidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak doldurma sonucu ile kap, büyük çanak ve vadiye bağlı gerçekleşmeler ayrı tutulur; yapıya bağlı örnekler genel bir kök anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kabı hareket ettirerek içindekilerin yerleşmesini ve kabın dolmasını ya da sıkışık hale gelmesini sağlamak; uzantı olarak bir şeyi bütünüyle doldurmaktır.

facets.statement: Kabın hareket ettirilmesi, içeriğin yerleşmesini ve kullanılabilir hacmin dolmasını sağlar.
İşlemden doğan tam doluluk veya sıkışık doluluk sonucu ayrıca adlandırılır.
Büyük bir çanağın ya da bir vadinin tamamen dolması sonuç kullanımına örnektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar kabı hareket ettirerek içeriği yerleştirme ile doluluk sonucu arasında birleşir; örnekler ölçek kabından çanak ve vadiye uzanır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem hareket ettirme işlemini hem de hedeflenen doluluk sonucunu korur.
